The Buot Brgy Hall\u2013Sitio Tabla Community Trail is a 3.34-kilometer point-to-point route from Buot-Taup Barangay Hall toward Sitio Tabla in Cebu City. I hiked it in October 2026, initially planning to complete a loop, but the constant ascent toward Sitio Tabla and the time spent documenting the route slowed my pace enough that I decided to end the hike there. <\/p>\n\n\n\n

Most of the route was on trail, with limited shade because of farming on the slopes. The route passes through areas where crops are extensively cultivated and where I encountered livestock, dogs, and mostly local users.<\/p>\n\n\n
